programme.desc: 'S26/E3 - Mega Mouthfuls'. Guy Fieri unhinges his jaw for some mega-mouthful meals. In Louisville, KY, a seafood spot piles their specialities on top of waffles and he visits a BBQ food truck.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E4 - Swiss, Sandwiches And Sausage'. Guy Fieri stops in Portland, OR, and Charlotte, NC, to sample grilled cheese sandwiches with a twist, schnitzel, sausage and Swiss specialities.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E5 - Beef, Lamb And Pig'. Guy Fieri hunts down meaty favourites in Kentucky and North Carolina. He enjoys an Irish pub's cottage pie, Asian-barbecue fusion and pimento-topped burgers.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E6 - Kickin' It In Cancun'. Guy Fieri feels the heat in Mexico! He checks out a family-owned spot where grandma cooks up rellenos. And, Guy shows off his Playa Del Carmen restaurant.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E7 - Not Your Typical Joints'. Guy checks out restaurants with funky dishes and unique specialties. They include an eatery tucked inside a beer store serving crazy waffle creations!

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S24/E7 - Colorful Spring Celebration'. The gang celebrate the spring season with colourful dishes. Sunny Anderson shares her delicious recipe for easy baked lemon sole with spring onions.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S43/E9 - Sweets Showdown: Doughnuts!'. The chefs must demonstrate doughnut dexterity as they create sweet, savoury and filled varieties using ingredients such as onions and grasshoppers!

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: 'S5/E10 - Happy Passover'. Molly Yeh puts her own twist on traditional recipes for Passover dinner. On the menu are Asian-inspired scallion and a hearty spiced beef pie.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: 'S8/E1 - Midwest Passover'. Molly Yeh celebrates Passover on the farm. She makes crispy giant skillet latke for lunch and a succulent spatchcock roast chicken with potatoes for dinner.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: 'S10/E13 - Spring Passover Shenanigans'. Molly celebrates Passover with heaps of delicious food, including sweet cinnamon sugar mixed berry matzo brei, hearty brisket hotdish and popover salad.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: 'S10/E2 - Easter Weekend'. Ree celebrates Easter on the ranch. She bakes and takes hot cross buns to her friends, then she makes tortellini primavera and a tasty spinach dip for her basket of crudités.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S23/E8 - April Fools' Day'. Guy Fieri invites six of his closest Flavortown judges to join him for April Fools' Day pranks as they remember Carl 'The Cuban' Ruiz's funniest GGG moments.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S35/E5 - Antonia Vs. Jet, Finals'. Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso's top students make an upscale entrée and an impressive graduation dinner for a chance to win $35,000.

programme.title: Triple D Nation: Burgers, Burritos...

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E2 of 8 - London 2015'. The 2015 Formula E London ePrix marked the season finale of the inaugural Formula E championship, where Nelson Piquet Jr. secured the Drivers' Championship title by winning the race.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E3 of 8 - Buenos Aires 2016'. Sam Bird claimed the first victory for the DS Virgin Racing partnership after fending off the charging Sebastien Buemi in Buenos Aires.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E4 of 8 - London 2016'. Senna came out on top at in the Gfinity Arena in London, claiming bragging rights in the virtual extension of one of the most famous battles in motorsport.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E5 of 8 - Mexico City 2017'. The 45-lap race was won by Audi Sport ABT driver Lucas di Grassi after starting from 15th position. Techeetah's Jean-Éric Vergne finished second and Virgin driver Sam Bird was third.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E6 of 8 - Montreal 2017'. The first 35-lap race was won by Audi Sport ABT driver Lucas di Grassi from pole position. The Techeetah duo of Jean-Éric Vergne and Stéphane Sarrazin finished in second and third places.

programme.title: Formula E - Flashback
programme.desc: 'S24/E7 of 8 - Punta Del Este 2018'. At the 2018 Formula E Punta del Este ePrix, Techeetah's Jean-Eric Vergne placed first, forcing Lucas di Grassi and Alex Lynn into second and third.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Asia Insight
programme.desc: Children of migrant families in Bangkok's largest slum are taking up musical instruments to play in an orchestra in the hope of having a brighter future.

programme.title: NHK Newsline

programme.title: My Eco-Friendly Farm
programme.desc: A woman from France is now an organic farmer in Okuma Town in Fukushima Prefecture - the town was affected by the 2011 nuclear accident and she is working to change that image.

programme.title: Japan's Top Inventions
programme.desc: Discover the stories behind renowned Japanese products alongside our reporter - this time, smokeless grills.

programme.title: Japanology Plus
programme.desc: Roughly 90% of Japan's plastic models are made in Shizuoka, an area whose manufacturing roots date back to shogun Tokugawa Ieyasu - we explore the latest developments for Japan's plastic models.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: A Testament To Japanese Diplomacy
programme.desc: This episode explores the vast diplomatic records of the late political scientist Iokibe Makoto, including exchanges with prime ministers which offer insights into navigating today's turbulent world.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The Perfect 2-Hour Guide
programme.desc: Kyoto: Journey through Kyoto's historic Kiyomizu-dera Temple - from its iconic stage and tranquil sacred spring, we unveil the definitive two-hour condensed course while basking in springtime beauty.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Train Cruise
programme.desc: Late April: spring has come to northern Japan. Travel the JR Ou and Gono Lines discovering cherry blossoms, hiking in a lush beech forest, soaking in a seaside spring and trying fermented soybeans.

programme.title: Japanology Plus Mini
programme.desc: Nostalgia is spreading in Japan for the Showa era (1926-1989) - we introduce electronics, retro designs, and other elements of a period that many Japanese people consider the 'good old days'.

programme.title: NHK Newsline

programme.desc: Crafts, fashion, products, buildings, and food: explore a diverse range of Japanese designs and the ideas and values of their creators. Our presenters visit designers at work to reveal new stories.

programme.desc: This show for kids promotes a greater understanding for people with difficulties and helps develop empathy - with the help of two fairies, the main character thinks about what can be done to help.

programme.title: Viewpoint Science
programme.desc: This proactive science education programme encourages primary and lower secondary school children to discover and investigate the mysteries which puzzle them.

programme.desc: Sushi is an iconic dish of Japan, with nigirizushi being the most popular style - we take a look at its evolution and the creation of key ingredients.

programme.title: Ukiyo-e Edo-Life
programme.desc: Discover the story behind the 36 Views of Mount Fuji woodprint series. The Great Wave off Kanagawa by Hokusai is not just a huge wave, and the boat caught in the wave is there for a reason.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
